title: SOTA Sweep — MC Dropout Calibration + Spatial Shot-Chart Embeddings + P5 Plateau Break

proposals.title: Monte Carlo Dropout calibration wrapper on S22 extra_trees checkpoint
proposals.source: MDPI 2026 — Uncertainty-Aware Machine Learning for NBA Forecasting (doi:10.3390/info17010056)
proposals.technique: T=30 stochastic forward passes via bootstrap ensemble sampling (tree model approximation of MC dropout). Average predictions yield calibrated probability distribution with uncertainty estimates.
proposals.expected_brier_gain: -0.003 to -0.005 (ECE 0.041→0.018 in source paper; direct Brier improvement ≈ 50% of ECE improvement)
proposals.implementation: New script: scripts/gpu-burst/mc_dropout_calibration.py. Load S22 checkpoint (.pkl), wrap with BootstrapMCWrapper(T=30, subsample=0.80), evaluate on 2024-25 holdout (9551 games). 30 bootstrap evals ≈ 5 min on Colab T4. Output: calibrated_brier, ECE, reliability diagram.
proposals.feasibility: HIGH — pure post-hoc, no retraining, scikit-learn compatible. GPU not required (tree inference is CPU). Colab T4 or even VM would work.
proposals.next_action: Write mc_dropout_calibration.py; schedule for next Colab T4 session

proposals.title: 24-zone spatial shot-chart embeddings as engine.py v3.2 feature category
proposals.source: MDPI 2026 uncertainty-aware paper (primary spatial technique), MDPI 2079-3197/13/10/230 (CNN confirmation)
proposals.technique: 24-zone court segmentation (paint/mid-range/3pt × left/center/right × corner/wing/above-break) × 3 metrics (shot_freq, FG_pct, eFG_pct) = 72 features per team. category name: 'shot_zones'. With 2 teams per game: 144 features added to engine.
proposals.expected_brier_gain: -0.005 to -0.010 (source paper attributes 0.021 SOTA gap to spatial features as key differentiator)
proposals.implementation: 1. Audit nba_cached_data.npz: check for shot_chart_detail columns. 2. If present, add 'shot_zones' category (144 features) to features/engine.py. 3. Bump version header to v3.2. 4. Deploy to all 6 NBA islands (MAX_FEATURES=200 cap — GA will select best subset). ETA: 1 VM session.
proposals.feasibility: MEDIUM — depends on nba_cached_data.npz shot zone coverage. nba_api.stats.endpoints.shotchartdetail available if not cached. Data pipeline work estimated 2-4h.
proposals.data_source: nba_cached_data.npz (check column list) OR nba_api.stats.endpoints.shotchartdetail (requires new scrape)
proposals.next_action: Audit nba_cached_data.npz column list for shot zone data; write engine.py extension if data exists

proposals.title: Break P1 (20-cycle) and P5 (3 hard-reset) political plateaus
proposals.observation: P1: 20 cycles at 0.25249 (exceeds 15-cycle diversify threshold). P5: 3 consecutive hard resets at 0.24993 — standard GA diversity exhausted.
proposals.technique: A) Diversify commands (already logged for VM cron). B) New political features: FEC donor density by congressional district, senate seat margin index (±5% swing), quarterly state GDP change, presidential approval by region. Add 5 features to political_engine.py.
proposals.expected_brier_gain: -0.001 to -0.003 per island (new optima created by expanded feature space)
proposals.implementation_a: VM cron sends: POST /api/command {"action":"diversify"} to P1 + P5. Already logged in health-status.json vm_cron_actions_required.
proposals.implementation_b: Review nomos-political-alpha/features/political_engine.py for underrepresented categories. Add 5 FEC-based features. Requires FEC scraper (nomos-browser-nba /api/scrape-fec) or manual data pull.
proposals.feasibility: HIGH for A (VM cron), MEDIUM for B (FEC scrape endpoint is stub per CLAUDE.md)
proposals.next_action: A: VM cron executes diversify (next autonomous-cycle.sh run). B: Review political_engine.py categories.

s15_win_analysis.observation: S15 (Nomos42/nba-evo-6) recovered from 0.22984 (catboost, COOLDOWN) to 0.22226 (xgboost, EVOLVING) in 1 brain cycle via natural GA algorithm evolution
s15_win_analysis.mechanism: GA fitness pressure forced algorithm switch from underperforming catboost to xgboost. 0.076 Brier point improvement.
s15_win_analysis.applicability_to_political: P1 (LightGBM, plateau 0.25249) and P7 (LightGBM, stable 0.25412) may follow same natural evolution. Allow 3-5 more cycles before considering forced algorithm injection. P4/P5 already on xgboost_brier.
s15_win_analysis.recommendation: Allow natural GA evolution for P1/P7. If still plateau after diversify, consider boosting mutation rate toward xgboost.
